thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-98765 — p99 latency SLO burn on inference-api (us-west). alert window 5m, p99 = 2.3s. link: https://alerts.internal/PD-98765
pagerduty-bot: Incident created and routed to eng-oncall rotation. Escalation: primary -> on-call -> standby.
alex_oncall: Acked. I'm on it :wave:  (1765558882)
jordan_eng: seeing the spike too on tail-latency dashboard — started ~05:12 UTC, correlated with a burst of long prompts. p95 up but p99 worse. screenshot: https://dashboards/internal/latency?range=15m
maya_sre: quickcheck: any deploys in last 30m? CI shows no production deploys. Running `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep inference-api` to check pod restarts.
lee_ops: autoscaler logs showing a scale attempt at 05:13 but some nodes failed to join due to nvlink mount errors. giving 503s on some pods. log snippet: ```ERROR attach-volume: device busy
WARN node-join: timeout```
cust-impact-aria: Ari_CSM: FYI I've skimmed customer reports — intermittent timeouts in a small subset of orgs, no broad outage reported yet. Escalating to SOC if it persists.
alex_oncall: trying fallback routing: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.local/route -d '{"service":"inference-api","to":"fallback-model-v1"}'` — will run canary to 10% first.
jordan_eng: logs show KV-cache thrash on shard 3 — eviction spike. suspect hotkey or very long context causing high mem churn. Query: can we evict prefix cache for that shard?
maya_sre: Doing targeted cache eviction for shard 3: `redis-cli -h kv-3 flushdb` (canary) — watch for effect. If not, plan B: divert traffic to smaller-context model.
incident-bot: PD note: Page acknowledged by alex_oncall. Time to acknowledge: 30s. Next escalation timer set to 10m.
lee_ops: node join fixed on two nodes, one still failing attach. I've put a host-level hold to prevent more join attempts until we patch. Patch scheduled in 15m.
alex_oncall: Can confirm p99 improved to ~600ms after partial autoscale + eviction. Still above SLO but trending down. Rolling divert to fallback model at 30% for another 5m.
ari_csm: Sending quick customer alert: small fraction of API requests may see higher latency for ~15-30m, we're monitoring.
jordan_eng: stack traces show some requests blocking on tokenizer for very long prompts. Adding short-term mitigation: reject >30k token requests at gateway with 429 to protect SLO. Patch deployed to gateway in prod (5s rollout).
maya_sre: After gateway patch + cache eviction + partial autoscale, p99 stable ~420ms. Still watching.
alex_oncall: Handing off to standby @maya_sre for 30m observation window. If p99 stays <600ms for 30m, we'll close. Otherwise reopen and escalate to eng-runtime.
maya_sre: Acknowledged handoff. I've subscribed to chart alerts and will post updates. Creating runbook note: https://runbooks.internal/inference/p99-burn-2026-03-18
pagerduty-bot: PD incident status: acknowledged -> monitoring. No escalations pending.
alex_oncall: thanks team :thumbsup: — documenting mitigation steps in the incident thread. Will update post-mortem if needed.
incident-bot: Thread closed for primary; standby monitoring active (30m).
